title: Chapter 173 Mu Yu Leaves
content:
Chapter 173 Mu Yu Leaves

"Mum Mu Yu, what did you say?"

Gu Chen was a little suspicious of his ears at this moment.

Mu Yu's face turned redder a little, he mustered up the courage and said to Gu Chen: "I said, I am willing to marry you."

In order to avoid Gu Chen not hearing it clearly, Mu Yu's voice was obviously a little louder.

At this moment, Gu Chen's mind went blank and he was completely confused.

Who am I, where am I, what happened.

Gu Chen asked three questions in his heart.

Aren't you talking about joining Huangcheng? Why did you suddenly marry yourself?

Although I really have a good impression of Mu Yu, a somewhat shy and interesting girl, it is not so fast.

Looking at Gu Chen was stunned.

Mu Yu noticed something was wrong.

"Gu Chen, didn't you say that you could guarantee my future?"

"Don't you want to marry me?"

Mu Yu bit his lip lightly. As a wise general who is planning, he is extremely flustered at this moment.

"Miss Mu Yu, you, you misunderstood what I mean."

Gu Chen touched his head and said a little embarrassedly.

Hearing Gu Chen's words, Mu Yu was stunned and then smiled.

Just a little bitter in smile.

"That's it, haha, sorry, I made the mistake."

Mu Yu seemed to have not taken this matter to heart, and his face was full of indifferent.

However, after Mu Yu finished saying this, he immediately turned around and left.

As I walked, the hot tears began to slowly slide from the corners of my eyes.

"Mu Yu, you are really embarrassing."

Mu Yu's choked voice rang out.

Standing there, Gu Chen suddenly felt a little panicked.

It's over.

It seems like I'm causing trouble.

And at this moment, a figure suddenly appeared beside Gu Chen.

"You guy, are you all pretending to be shit in your mind?!"

An Xing looked at Gu Chen with a look of regret and said hatefully.

Obviously, none of this escaped An Xing's eyes.

"This, this, this, I can't blame me all."

Gu Chen was a little ashamed and felt guilty when he spoke.

An Xing sneered.

"What, I think I can't deserve you?"

"They are so proactive, but you don't react at all."

As the saying goes, a woman chases a man, and she will break it with a layer of yarn.

You are fine, you don't even take a look.

Listening to An Xing ridicule him, Gu Chen was a little at a loss.

"Then what do you think now?"

Upon hearing this, An Xing also put away his sneer and said seriously: "What else can I do? If you don't like it, don't worry. If you like it, go chase it."

If you like it, go chase it?

Gu Chen’s first thought was that he probably didn’t like it.

After all, I have known each other for how long.

Just because I saved the other party’s life?

But my idea has always been to recruit Mu Yu to join the Huangcheng.

Standing there, Gu Chen was silent for a long time.

Finally, Gu Chen waved his hand and then turned around and left.

Only a somewhat lonely back was left.

"Where are you going?"

When An Xing saw Gu Chen leave, he asked.

"Go to retreat, don't bother me anymore."

Obviously, Gu Chen was a little upset.

Seeing Gu Chen choosing to escape, An Xing shook his head and sighed.

He just wants to say that when you regret it, it is time for you to endure hardships.

It’s a pity that Gu Chen has disappeared from his vision.

And on the other side.

"Huh? Mu Yu! What's wrong with you?"

Walking to a corner, Lu Xue took Jian Xin and others, and by chance, she happened to meet Mu Yu.

At this moment, Mu Yu's expression was low, his eyes were red, and the tears on his cheeks had not yet dissipated.

Seeing this scene, Jian Xin immediately stepped forward anxiously to ask.

"I, I'm fine."

Mu Yu lowered his head and shook his head slightly, his voice like fine lines.

Seeing Mu Yu like this, Jian Xin didn't understand what was going on.

Suddenly, a sharp sword intent slowly overflowed from Jian Xin's body.

Obviously, Jian Xin was angry.

"Mu Yu, why have you suffered in the deserted city? Tell me, I'll make the decision for you."

At this time, Lu Xue stepped forward and said seriously.

The people around were all generals of the Divine Dynasty. They were usually very respectful to Mu Yu, who was ranked third. When they saw Mu Yu like this, everyone was also angry.

"The Shepherd God General, everyone is here, our God Dynasty is not afraid of trouble."

"Yes, let alone His Highness and His Majesty, how can you be wronged in the deserted city?"

Listening to everyone's remarks, Mu Yu was indifferent and just said softly: "Everyone, I want to go back to the imperial capital."

"Mu Yu."

At this time, Jian Xin also restrained his breath and looked at Mu Yu with a soft look.

"Let's go, I'll go back with you."

Immediately, Jian Xin turned around and saluted Lu Xue with a respectful salute, "Your Highness, Princess, thank you for your reception, but this wasteland city is obviously not suitable for us."

"Goodbye."

After saying that, Jian Xin pulled Mu Yu and left the Huangcheng directly.

"well,,"

In place, Lu Xue looked at the two who were leaving and wanted to call each other, but she swallowed it.

At this time, several gods around him also spoke, "Your Highness, Princess, we will leave first."

"If you see Your Majesty, please inform us, and we will all wait for Your Majesty to return in the Divine Court."

Wow.

Suddenly, only Lu Xue was left standing in the street in a mess.

"Ahhhhhh!!"

"Master stupid!!!"

Lu Xue was a little furious, stamped her feet, and then shouted angrily: "An Xing!!"

The next moment, An Xing appeared beside Lu Xue in an instant.

"Miss, you are looking for me?"

An Xing asked knowingly.

Lu Xue took a deep breath, took An Xing to a place where no one was, and then asked what happened between Gu Chen and Mu Yu.

After a long time.

"I am so angry, so angry."

"Master is such a blockhead!"

Lu Xue was so angry that she danced with joy. She couldn't believe that Mu Yu was already like this, but Gu Chen didn't have any idea.

Could it be?

"An Xing, my master doesn't have a problem with his sexual orientation, right?"

Lu Xue asked a soul-searching question.

Hearing this, An Xing was stunned for a moment, then shook his head and said, "Impossible, I've seen him secretly reading a little H book before."

However, after saying this, An Xing realized that something was wrong, and hurriedly coughed lightly, and continued: "There is definitely no problem with his sexual orientation, but his reaction should be a little slow."

An Xing looked around carefully, and then leaned close to Lu Xue's ear.

"Miss, I have secretly investigated, and Gu Chen has never touched a woman."

"What?"

Lu Xue was stunned.

It was really unexpected that her master was still a virgin.

The two knew that this was a very embarrassing thing, so they tacitly didn't say anything.

"So are they both done?"

Lu Xue finally asked.

An Xing spread his hands, "I don't know about this, it depends on him."

Hearing this, Lu Xue sighed and said nothing more.

Just like that, the deserted city returned to peace.

In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
